cues.text: Your room. Ryoji stands by the window, eyes closed, then turns to you.
You both sit on the bed.
Ryoji smiles, goes to the window.
You sit a moment, head bowed, then get up and face him.
Ryoji nods and closes his eyes. You lower your head, then raise your Evoker to your own temple, and the scene fades away.
Ryoji walks to the room's middle. A swirling column swallows him. A tall masked figure with huge blade-like wings hangs there.
The figure vanishes, and Ryoji stands there again, smiling.
You sit a moment with your head bowed, then get up and walk over to Ryoji.
Ryoji nods and closes his eyes. You lower your head, then raise your Evoker to your own temple, and the scene fades away.
The masked figure bursts apart; Ryoji stands there again.
